text:
My wings?

two rotten petals

my reason?

little cups of sour wine

my life?

a well-considered void

my body?

a gash in the chair

my rocking?

a childish gong

my face?

a disguised zero

my eyes?

ah! pieces of infinity

translation.title: My Wings?...
translation.editorial_note: The question-and-answer form is kept abrupt, with each image left bare.
